# Accepted opening-level baseline

These four scripts were extracted without modification from the user's signed
`Velvet_Fling_After_Hours_0.1.2_BloomFix_TEST.apk` (SHA-256
`9d8c80d3bcbaaa6c5da236c6d864a7cb95773a5f6ca91c97075bdde90d74b245`).
The user reported the Bloom update worked and the first level was otherwise
perfect. The fixture lets regression tests compare the approved level's initial
layout and simulated shot outcomes with later versions. It does not represent a
human playtest or verify device-specific rendering, audio, or touch feel.
